raw_segments.text: His eyes followed the high figure in homespun, beard, and bicycle, a listening woman at
Coming from the vegetarian, only wega-bobbles and fruit, don't eat a beef steak.
If you do, the eyes of that cow will pursue you through all eternity.
Winded with terry, though, tried it.
Keep you on the run all day, bad as a bloater, dreams all night.
Why do they call that thing they gave me nut steak, nutrients, fruitarians, to give you
the idea you are eating rump steak?
Keep you sitting by the tap all night.
